name: Sylveon
flavor: Sylveon cuts an elegant figure as it dances lightly around, feelers fluttering, but its piercing moves aim straight for its opponents’ weak spots.

ability.name: Soothing Ribbon
ability.effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, you may heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.
